case.promise: Product complexity presented through a direct journey with honest privacy and status.
case.summary: This case study covers the website as a communication delivery. The ClubAL product page remains dedicated to the Windows software, its modules and deployment.

tabs.label: Challenge
tabs.title: Explain a three-module product without overwhelming the first visit.
tabs.body: The content needed to present value, workflow and limits before technical detail, keeping the product understandable for visitors who do not know its architecture.

tabs.label: Architecture
tabs.title: The narrative follows the visitor’s decision.
tabs.body: The page starts with the operational outcome, shows how the three modules connect and leads into deployment, frequently asked questions and direct contact.

tabs.label: Delivery
tabs.title: A published, localized experience with no tracking.
tabs.body: The website supports Portuguese, English and Spanish, light and dark themes, responsive layout, local assets and static publishing on Cloudflare Pages.

case.galleryNote: Captures of the public website taken on July 28, 2026; internal product screens use demonstration data.
